status: DAR-only records: 36 original sessions plus 12 separately recorded primary-profile repeat sessions. Default remains disabled.

method.scope: Original TPC-H-derived SF10 scattered DV tables, snapshots and SQL. This is not a rerun of the published five-reader comparison.
method.sampling: Three fresh-process sessions per mode/table/network on one executable. Each initializes one provider and runs two sequential queries. Every declared sample is retained; none was replaced.
method.initialization: Both modes load planning metadata. Automatic mode also profiles the network during initialization with a five-second sampling limit. Each automatic session transferred 13.5 MiB in 396 calibration requests before the first query.
method.timing: Query durations exclude initialization. Add initialization to the first query within each session before taking medians. Report the second query separately. The session includes initialization and both queries.
method.io: Split Parquet I/O at the two 64 KiB tail reads per candidate file, checked against object sizes in the verified upload receipts. Profiling requests precede the first query. All Parquet responses completed with HTTP 206. Session HTTP counters include all object classes and both queries.
method.cache: fresh processes; reused OS and MinIO caches; validation before timing
method.preparation: This campaign completed compilation and metadata-only verification before timing, without regenerating, uploading or rehashing the large fixtures. An unrelated build overlapped part of the primary network measurements; see host_load.
method.correctness: Before timing each case, both modes exported both queries. All 24 exports matched every reference value and null, with 894 rows. Timed queries also returned 894 rows.
method.retries: Unknown. Repeated identical ranges are counted but cannot identify SDK retries.
method.incomplete_bodies: Incomplete responses were confined to delta_log objects. Per-session counts are retained; they are not retry counts. No Parquet response was incomplete.
method.decision_logs: Cost decisions and measured profiles are from separate validation runs, not the timing samples. Query byte/request counters come from each timing sample itself.

host_load.observed_interference: Unrelated maturin/cargo/rustc activity was observed while 90-primary was running. The campaign controller was paused before starting the 1 Gbps profiles, while the active case finished. It resumed after ten seconds without a detected build.
host_load.caveat: The host was shared. Polling does not establish isolation, and the 150 Mbps timings must not be presented as a clean reproduction of the earlier gains.

pause.reason: Hold the campaign controller before starting the next profile while an unrelated build is running. The active 90-primary subprocess continues to completion.
